note: Sentences of triggers a focus, decision, event or idea can show (TRIGGER_* keys). Terms come from the glossary; every variable and colour code of the installed key is kept. Triggers of systems ZIN removes (cryptology, carriers, nukes) keep plain Erdae text so a stray one shows no modern word.
